description: A native control plane for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and other coding agents
notes: Zeron keeps its data in "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Zeron" and updates its own executable from GitHub releases. Set ZERON_AUTO_UPDATE=0 to keep the Scoop-managed build in place until "scoop update zeron".
On Windows only the desktop app and its CLI are supported; "zeron daemon" needs launchd or systemd.
